items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability Leading to Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could allow for unauthenticated customer account takeover. This issue was addressed in Adobe Security Bulletin APSB26-92.

items.id: PolyShell (CVE not explicitly stated in snippets, but associated with fix in 2.4.9)
items.title: Unrestricted File Upload via REST API (PolyShell)
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw, named PolyShell, in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by disguising code as an image. Adobe released Magento 2.4.9 containing the fix, but older supported versions require specific mitigation.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution in Adobe Commerce. Exploitation requires both authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (B2B)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass in Adobe Commerce. Exploitation requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability Leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.
